hints.title: Sort to Place Closest Elements Adjacent
hints.text: The minimum difference between any two elements in an array must occur between two adjacent elements once sorted.

hints.title: Find Minimum Adjacent Gap
hints.text: Scan the sorted array once to compute the smallest difference between arr[i] and arr[i - 1].

hints.title: Collect All Pairs Matching the Gap
hints.text: In a second pass, append every adjacent pair having difference equal to the discovered minimum gap.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minimumAbsDifference(self, arr: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        arr.sort()
        min_diff = min(arr[i] - arr[i - 1] for i in range(1, len(arr)))
        return [[arr[i - 1], arr[i]] for i in range(1, len(arr)) if arr[i] - arr[i - 1] == min_diff]
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs requires O(N^2) time, which is too slow for 10^5 elements.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting in O(N log N) limits comparisons strictly to adjacent items with O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that sorting guarantees the closest elements are adjacent.
